title: Menús en Dúo
description: Two players (docs/party.md), each on their own pad: each opens their own half of the user menu and moves in it on its own. Personaje: each picks the ánima they wear from their cards (their own and their extras), with its level, shared with whoever wears it. Ánimas: each equips their extras; one the other has shows their face and cannot be taken until they let it go, and the other half updates at once. Mapa: each half is centred on its own player, who is the one that pulses. Two standard gamepads are faked in the page.

steps.eval: const s = window.gerard.story; s.merge(['papagato','papagato-2','papagato-3','papagato-4','anima-universidad','dadaista-2','dadaista-3','anima-marta','sincopante-2','anima-luca','prismatico-2','anima-emilie']); s.xp = { papagato: 2600, dadaista: 1300, sincopante: 700, prismatico: 500, freatica: 100 }; s.equip('gerard', 'papagato'); s.equip('aitor', 'sincopante'); s.wear('gerard', 'papagato');

window.fakePad = i => ({ id: 'Xbox Wireless Controller', index: i, connected: true, mapping: 'standard', timestamp: 0, axes: [0, 0, 0, 0], buttons: Array.from({ length: 17 }, () => ({ pressed: false, value: 0 })) }); window.fakePads = [fakePad(0), fakePad(1)]; navigator.getGamepads = () => window.fakePads; window.frames = n => new Promise(done => { const tick = () => n-- > 0 ? requestAnimationFrame(tick) : done(); tick(); }); window.tap = async (pad, button) => { window.fakePads[pad].buttons[button].pressed = true; await frames(4); window.fakePads[pad].buttons[button].pressed = false; await frames(4); };
